required_adapter_behavior: Load fixtures/manifest.json from the pinned PR #237 kit commit; do not copy fixtures.
Accept POS-CANONICAL-FLOW-001 only after schema, protected header, RFC 8785 Ed25519 signature, time, revision, audience, and idempotency validation.
Recheck the authoritative connection revision before credential lease, Brainbase write, and Slack delivery.
Accept a credential lease only when lease_id, contract_revision, max_uses=1, TTL, and all binding fields match.
Keep collection_state independent from outcome and never translate partial or not_collected into zero or success.
Own only queue_execution and slack_delivery claims; submit observed usage and Receipts to Brainbase canonical storage.
Reject every manifest negative case with its exact expected_code before the protected boundary.
Keep every required capability active for the non-applicable fixture.
required_test_name: mana-runtime consumer reads PR237 canonical fixture manifest

result_contract.positive: all canonical messages accepted with no mutation
result_contract.negative: all expected codes observed and business API called=false
result_contract.non_applicable: mandatory capability waiver count remains zero
